h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rampur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rampur

items.pText: Rampur, in the Rohilkhand plains of western Uttar Pradesh, is known for its princely-state past and the Raza Library. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, housing colonies and gardens in the city and the district. We make it at our own factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,220 km away, and deliver it by road.

Not every buyer can fund a full play area in one go. A school or colony committee in Rampur might start with a swing, a slide and a see-saw this year, then add a larger structure later. We plan for that from the start. Our layout drawing shows the full play area and the safe zone around each piece, so the first items sit in the right place and later additions fit around them.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Building a Rampur playground in stages

c: If you are phasing the project, buy the pieces that keep the most children busy first. A
each take several children at once. A larger multi play system can come in the next phase.

Leave space for that second phase and keep it clear of trees, drains and boundary walls. Lay the base and drainage for the whole area at the start, since redoing ground work later costs more. facts.value: About 1,220 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can we buy a few pieces now and add more later?
items.a: Yes. We draw the full layout first and mark which pieces belong to each phase. You order the first set now, and later items go into the space already planned for them.

items.q: Will the equipment cope with Rampur's hot summers and foggy winters?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle heat and damp well. Shade over slides helps in May and June, when surfaces in direct sun can get uncomfortably hot.

items.q: Who installs the equipment in Rampur?
items.a: Our installation team or a dealer in north India. They fix it using the self-standing or grouting method, whichever suits your ground and the piece being installed.
